Add a gentle, soothing melody to your space with this handmade white capiz shell wind chime. Featuring delicate translucent shells that shimmer in the sunlight, this elegant wind chime is perfect for boho, coastal, and minimalist home decor. The top is carefully handwoven with natural rattan, enhancing its organic, rustic charm. As the breeze passes through, the shells create a soft, tranquil sound that brings a calming seaside atmosphere to any setting.

Handcrafted with Natural Materials
Each wind chime is uniquely made from ethically sourced capiz shells, which are lightweight and produce a delicate, soothing tone when touched by the wind. The woven rattan top adds a touch of earthy elegance, making it a perfect accent for patios, gardens, balconies, and indoor spaces. Whether hung near a window or in an outdoor setting, this wind chime brings a sense of peace and relaxation.

Versatile Coastal Decor & Meaningful Gift
Ideal for beach houses, meditation spaces, bohemian interiors, and nature-inspired homes, this wind chime complements any setting with its serene aesthetics. It also makes a thoughtful gift for nature lovers, yoga enthusiasts, or anyone who appreciates mindful living. Let the gentle music of capiz shells enhance your space with harmony and tranquility.
